title: Can Rabbits Eat Watermelon?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Watermelon?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage, bedding guide and hay guide.
- Replace the image URLs below with your watermelon images once uploaded.
-->

<section class="rcw-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-watermelon">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcw-page,
    .rcw-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcw-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcw-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcw-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcw-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcw-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcw-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcw-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcw-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcw-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcw-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcw-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcw-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcw-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcw-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcw-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcw-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcw-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcwFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcw-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcw-hero-title-overlay .rcw-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcw-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcw-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcw-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcw-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcw-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcw-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcw-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcw-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcw-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcw-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcw-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcw-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcw-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcw-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcw-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcw-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcw-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcw-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcw-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcw-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rcw-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcw-section h2,
    .rcw-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcw-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcw-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcw-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcw-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcw-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcw-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcw-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rcw-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcw-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcw-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcw-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcw-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcw-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcw-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcw-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcw-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcw-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcw-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcw-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcw-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcw-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcw-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcw-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcw-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcw-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcw-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcw-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcw-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rcw-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcw-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rcw-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcw-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcw-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcw-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcw-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcw-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcw-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcw-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcw-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcw-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcw-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcw-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcw-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcw-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcw-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcw-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcw-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcw-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcw-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcw-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcw-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcw-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-watermelon-2.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcw-final-box .rcw-pill,
    .rcw-final-box h2,
    .rcw-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcw-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcw-final-box .rcw-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcw-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcw-related,
    .rcw-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcw-related .rcw-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcw-related .rcw-section-header .rcw-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rcw-related .rcw-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcw-related .rcw-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rcw-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcw-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcw-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }

    .rcw-related-card img {

          <span class="rcw-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys watermelon</h2>
          <p>
            When given in moderation, watermelon can add variety and make treat time interesting. Even if your rabbit loves it, fruit should always be limited.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcw-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Adds variety</h3>
            <p>A tiny watermelon cube can add occasional variety to a hay-based diet.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Soft texture</h3>
            <p>Some rabbits enjoy the soft, juicy texture, but this is also why portions must stay tiny.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of nutrients</h3>
            <p>Watermelon contains some vitamins and plant nutrients, but it should not replace leafy greens or hay.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Summer treat</h3>
            <p>A tiny piece may be enjoyed occasionally in warm weather, alongside constant access to fresh water.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over quickly, nibble eagerly, lick the juice or search for more.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcw-benefit">
            <h3>Still limit treats</h3>
            <p>Even enthusiastic rabbits should only have watermelon occasionally to keep their diet balanced.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcw-section rcw-faq rcw-reveal" id="faq">
      <div class="rcw-narrow">
        <div class="rcw-section-header">
          <span class="rcw-pill">Watermelon FAQs</span>
          <h2>Watermelon questions for rabbit owners</h2>
          <p>
            Quick answers about serving watermelon safely, what to remove and when to avoid it.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcw-faq-list">
          <details class="rcw-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat watermelon safely?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat a tiny amount of ripe watermelon flesh as an occasional treat. It should be fresh, plain and served without seeds or rind.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcw-faq-item">
            <summary>How much watermelon can a rabbit eat?</summary>
            <p>A tiny cube once in a while is enough for most rabbits. Watermelon is very watery and sugary, so it should not be a daily or regular treat.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcw-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat watermelon rind?</summary>
            <p>It is best to remove the rind before feeding watermelon. Offer only a tiny piece of the soft red flesh.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcw-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat watermelon seeds?</summary>
            <p>Watermelon seeds should be removed before feeding because they are unnecessary and may be a choking risk.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcw-faq-item">
            <summary>Can baby rabbits eat watermelon?</summary>
            <p>Baby rabbits should not be given watermelon. Young rabbits need a steady diet based on hay and age-appropriate foods, with treats introduced only when they are older and already eating fresh foods safely.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcw-final rcw-reveal">
      <div class="rcw-wrap rcw-final-box">
        <span class="rcw-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Watermelon can be a safe occasional treat for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat a tiny amount of watermelon flesh as an occasional treat. However, because watermelon is very watery and contains natural sugars, it should be offered rarely and in small portions.
        </p>
        <p>
          Always remove the seeds and rind before feeding watermelon. A rabbit’s diet should still be based mainly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens forming the rest of their daily food.
        </p>
